title: ClockPolicy v1 — clock discipline as data: the law is constants — no single node's clock is ever trusted (single_clock_trusted always false) and a node's skew is judged by the median of its observers (consensus_method always median, one latest vote per observer); a node needs at least min_observers corroborating observers before any verdict on it can be trusted, a corroborated median skew within max_trusted_skew_seconds is trusted, beyond it the node is skewed, and beyond severe_skew_seconds its timestamps are refused; max_nodes bounds the watch — the ordering max_trusted < severe is enforced by the watch's own validation on top of this schema (Y-068)
